name: research-guard
description: Fail-closed cross-disciplinary research initialization, ideation, collision verification, evidence, reproducibility, five-way formula checks, OpenReview calibration, scientific-image integrity, writing, and paper audits.

interface.shortDescription: Design research and enforce novelty, language, and evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Research Guard supports hash-bound cross-disciplinary field initialization, evidence-bounded ideation, mandatory collision reruns after method or field-profile changes, structured claim evidence, frozen protocols, resource-bounded reproducibility, DOI-verified citations, exact venue evidence, truthful figures, user-owned limitation and ethics decisions, and 2-3-role manuscript audits. Formula work reports Lean logic, Pint dimensions, SymPy algebra, Z3 constraints, and protocol-admitted numerical checks separately; public OpenReview data calibrates review coverage without predicting acceptance; scientific-image signals require hash-bound expert review.
defaultPrompt: Register my research method and run a strict novelty check.
Analyze this discipline and initialize its evidence profile before a deep literature review.
Explore ideas, then register a falsifiable hypothesis and experiment plan.
Audit my manuscript with linked sources, Lean formulas, figures, and experiment evidence.
